The total return includes the Premium on issuance of Units. This premium represents the difference in NAV as a result of Transactional NAV (discussed in Note 5) being higher than the NAV under GAAP. The transactional NAV per Unit is the price at which transactions in the Units are made.</span><span style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;"> </span></div></div><div class="item-list-element-wrapper"         </tr>
       </table><p style="tab-size:26.66px;font-size:10pt;margin-top:0;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;"><span style="white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">&#160;</span></p><div class="item-list-element-wrapper" style="tab-size:32px;display:flex;font-size:10pt;margin-top:0;justify-content:flex-start;font-family:Times New Roman;align-items:baseline;margin-bottom:0;min-width:4.537%;text-align:left;"><span style="color:#221e1f;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:4.537%;word-break:keep-all;display:inline-flex;justify-content:flex-start;">(a)</span><div style="display:inline;"><span style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">Total return is measured based on the beginning Net Asset Value adjusted for cash flows related to capital contributions or withdrawals during the period. Returns are geometrically linked based on the timing cash flows during the period.</span></div></div><div class="item-list-element-wrapper" style="tab-size:32px;display:flex;font-size:10pt;margin-top:6pt;justify-content:flex-start;font-family:Times New Roman;align-items:baseline;margin-bottom:0;min-width:4.537%;text-align:left;"><span style="color:#221e1f;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:4.537%;word-break:keep-all;display:inline-flex;justify-content:flex-start;">(b)</span><div style="display:inline;"><span style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">Ratios are not annualized</span><span style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">.</span></div></div><span></span>
</td>
</tr>
</table>
<div style="display: none;">
